proposal.reason: Main functional change is review/merge automation policy: .github/scripts/review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py redefine module-based invitations and approval requirements, while new/renamed workflows (review-routing.yml, review-module.yml, review-gate.yml, review-squash-preview.yml) rewire gate refresh and squash-preview triggering; these are contribution/review workflow behaviors, not CI test-system changes.
